title: Law to cut waste and single-use items at street fairs
summary: This bill would require organizers of permitted street activities like festivals and block parties to properly dispose of and recycle trash, and to provide food-related items such as straws, utensils and napkins only upon request, mostly in compostable form. Organizers would need to submit waste compliance plans, keep some plastic straws available on request with signage, and could face civil penalties of $25 to $2,000 per event for violations. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
